answer: An farming party running 45 aliases hence needs 56 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are entered in ledge, expire in whisper, and haven lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2762 identities would post 2091 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
